AWPTCM-T37869.objective:
• Stopping a unit fan (e.g. XEM or PSU fan) causes the System LED to indicate a fault by flashing red at 1 flash per period (on some platforms if applicable).
  • Fault LED patterns distinguish fan stop (1 flash red) from other environment faults such as faulty XEM (4 flashes) or temperature alarms (on some platforms if applicable).
  • Concurrent faults (XEM, temp, fan) cause the fault LED to light in specific sequences of flashes (on some platforms if applicable).

steps.description: Note: Related ART Tests linked in Traceability. Primary: AWP-11637 (System LED - fan stop). Top relevant: AWP-10432 (fan stop), AWP-11638 (faulty XEM 4 flashes), AWP-11640 (concurrent faults sequences), AWP-17692 (system failure LED). ART: 1358/5700 platform environment monitoring (fan/temp status, system health). LED details may vary on some platforms if applicable.
Cause a unit fan to stop (e.g. XEM fan or PSU fan). Verify the System LED flashes red at 1 flash per period (or equivalent fault indication on some platforms if applicable).
Verify distinction from other faults (e.g. 4 flashes for faulty XEM, sequences for concurrent XEM/temp/fan alarms).
